definitions.registered: After world._load_data, including local merged records; monsters and bosses partition the expanded runtime registry.
definitions.spawn_referenced: Unique registered monster names present in effective map spawn definitions after MonsterCatalog.apply_map.
definitions.spawn_capacity: Configured region max_count sum; not simultaneously live actors and not a per-species count.
definitions.unique_rgba_frames: Exact visible pixel diversity; duplicates excluded. Changes caused by translation, scale or deformation are not proof of articulated animation.
definitions.unique_alpha_cropped_frames: Exact diversity after removing transparent margins; pure translation does not increase it.
definitions.directions_declared: Manifest layout count, not independently verified original viewpoints.
definitions.runtime_load_pass: Godot resource load, map definition parse, or skill preset registration; does not assert full effect execution or visual quality.
definitions.delivery: Repository file presence only; original_* legacy ledger statuses remain authoritative and not_delivered.
